extracted.intended_audience: NSF proposal applicants, awardees, and research administration staff
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on which version of the NSF Proposal & Award Policies and Procedures Guide (PAPPG) and associated policy notices/supplements apply to proposals, applications, and awards based on submission or award dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: PAPPG as authoritative source
rubrics_metrics.description: The Proposal and Award Policies and Procedures Guide (PAPPG) is the source for information about the proposal and award process at the U.S. National Science Foundation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the PAPPG as the primary, authoritative reference for rules and procedures governing NSF proposals and awards. When preparing or administering NSF proposals/awards, consult the PAPPG for applicable policy, formatting, and procedural requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Version applicability rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Each version of the PAPPG applies to all proposals or applications submitted while that version is effective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determine which PAPPG version governs a proposal by the proposal's submission or due date: the policies and requirements in the version effective at that time control application preparation and review. Do not apply policies from a different PAPPG version unless specifically directed by NSF policy notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy notices implement changes to a PAPPG version
rubrics_metrics.description: The following policy notices implement changes to the PAPPG 24-1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NSF issues policy notices/supplements (e.g., NSF 26-200, NSF 26-202) that modify or add to the PAPPG; these notices specify the scope and effective dates of the changes and must be followed as indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplement 1 (NSF 26-200) applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplement 1 (NSF 26-200) — Applies to all financial assistance awarded on or after Dec. 8, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For awards of financial assistance with award dates on or after Dec. 8, 2025, the provisions in Supplement 1 (NSF 26-200) apply to the award. Check Supplement 1 text for specific policy changes and implementation instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplement 2 (NSF 26-202) applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplement 2 (NSF 26-202) — Applies to all financial assistance awarded on or after Jan. 22, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For awards of financial assistance with award dates on or after Jan. 22, 2026, the provisions in Supplement 2 (NSF 26-202) apply. Review the supplement for the exact modifications to PAPPG 24-1 and any transitional instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current PAPPG version effective date (NSF 24-1)
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF 24-1 applies to all proposals submitted or due on or after May 20, 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals submitted or due on or after May 20, 2024 must comply with the policies and requirements in NSF 24-1. Use the NSF 24-1 document (and any applicable supplements/policy notices) when preparing and submitting proposals during this effective period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Previous PAPPG versions and their effective dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists prior PAPPG versions and their effective dates (e.g., NSF 23-1 effective Jan. 30, 2023; NSF 22-1 effective Oct. 4, 2021; NSF 20-1 effective June 1, 2020; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If dealing with proposals, awards, or records from prior periods, consult the specific PAPPG version that was effective at that time. The page provides a chronology of previous PAPPG versions and replacement relationships to help determine which historic rules applied.
